plan.notes: Source: 'BFA Performing Arts: Music Education-Instrumental - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Performing Arts), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. *MUTH 1093 Fundamentals of Music Theory is remedial (credit does not count toward the major requirements) and is omitted from the sequence. **MACP Class Piano I-IV sequenced at 0 credits (lower bound; piano requirement fulfilled by passing the proficiency exam). Semester credit totals match the catalog's printed lower bounds. Sequenced total is 129; the catalog prints 'Total hours required for major - 125' and the requirements header prints '130-134 Hours' - both differ from the lower-bound sequenced sum, which is kept per convention. Placeholder codes normalized: catalog 'MA__ 1002' etc. rendered as 'MA 1002' (primary-instrument applied instruction; instrument-specific prefixes MABS, MAPC, MACL, MASA, MAEU, MATP, MAFH, MATR, MAFL, MATU, MAOB, MAST); catalog 'MUEN_1__1'/'MUEN_3__1' rendered as 'MUEN 1X11'/'MUEN 3X11' (level-specific ensembles; see Major Ensemble Electives); catalog 'MUED_3__1 WW, Br, or Per Methods' rendered as 'MUED 3XX1' (1-credit woodwind/brass/percussion methods; specific method course set with advisor; the plan sequences three such methods courses across semesters 6-7). Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. REPEATS (per SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog): MUED 1000 Concert/Recital Attendance is required for 6 semesters ('All music majors except musical theatre majors are required to register for MUED 1000'); MUEN ensembles (1071/3071 Instrumental Ensemble, 1141/3141 Heritage Singers, 1061/3061 Chamber Singers, 3051 Marching Band) and applied instruction (MAVC Voice, MAGU Guitar) are sequenced every term per the catalog plans; allow_repeated_courses set 2026-10-01.
